title: Still There
summary: Narrative puzzle adventure set on an isolated space station, combining technical manual-driven maintenance puzzles, an AI companion, dark humor and a story centered on grief and isolation.

observations.statement: Story, atmosphere and emotional tone are recurring strengths in the available reviews.
The technical puzzles are described as creative and satisfying by some players but also challenging or frustrating by others.
The Steam store lists Russian interface and subtitle support.

conflicts.statement: The manual-driven puzzle design is praised for creativity and challenge while a minority of reviewers find the puzzles overly frustrating.

steam_reviews.query: Steam Community review pages; Russian and non-Russian lanes attempted; accessible index was sparse
